touches.text: proof_coverage: joins a ticket's falsifier clauses to the proofs that cover them and the seals that ran green. WHY: a falsifier nobody proves is a hypothesis (Law 3). USERS: the tester.
VERBS: run, notices, CodeMother's verbs reached over the bus (RULE 1). COMMANDS: cairn codemother test (--hollow, --seal, --exec, ...), shortcut cairn test; proofgate (the hook: proofs run by hand).

Scratch bus: a proof needs a bus it controls (a real store, stub devices, nobody live listening), so the cairn device publishes scratch_bus, the way db_domain's client carries scratch(). Akien 2026-11-12, answering Q#86 (8 proof imports of the bus machine in tester, codemother and librarian, measured 2026-11-11): "works for me". 2.3.8Every device has the panes the base shim defines (17.1.3.5.2), drawn by the web server (15):
The detect-and-start lives in one tool, the waker, and it sits inside connect: every client's connect is a wake attempt, so no caller can forget one. A probe watches and reports; the waker acts.
scratch: a proof's throwaway temp dirs and worktrees, cleaned up by the door. WHY: a run must leave nothing behind (4.3.1.7). USERS: the tester.
